title: MIRAGE: Defending Long-Form RAG Against Misinformation Pollution

live_model.evidence: "We further evaluate 600 claims ... using GPT-5-mini, GPT-4.1-nano, GPT-4o, and GPT-5.5 (OpenAI, 2026), obtaining a mean agreement of 92.33% with VeriScore"

prompt.note: GPT-4.1-nano is one of four external judges checking VeriScore label agreement; no per-model number or prompt is given for this role.

claim.metric: mean agreement with VeriScore across 4 judge models (not isolated per model)
claim.location: Sec. "VeriScore labels validation": mean agreement 92.33% across GPT-5-mini/GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4o/GPT-5.5

data.source: LongFact, Biography, AlpacaFact (public long-form QA benchmarks); VeriScore factuality labels

notes: The paper's own backbones (main Table 1 results) are GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-mini, neither of which is this row's live id. GPT-4.1-nano contributes only to a 4-way judge-agreement average with no per-model breakdown.
